description: Formal scenario contract specifying target capacity, bounded performance SLOs, and overload saturation thresholds for PolicyHelix local open-source profile.
invariants: Decision deadline <= 200ms enforced (fail-closed timeout 504 on breach)
Oversized payloads > 64 KiB rejected 413 without memory bloat
Client cancellations fail closed 499 without goroutine leakage
Saturation beyond worker capacity fails closed 429 without queue starvation
Durable state persists across engine restart under load without data loss

workload_scenarios.name: Bounded Target Workload
workload_scenarios.description: Evaluates 10 sequential and concurrent authorization requests within the 64 KiB payload limit and verifies latency p95 <= 200ms.

workload_scenarios.name: Concurrent Burst Workload
workload_scenarios.description: Evaluates 20 concurrent authorization requests across 10 workers verifying zero race conditions, low memory delta, and bounded latency.

workload_scenarios.name: Oversized Payload Overload
workload_scenarios.description: Sends payload exceeding 64 KiB bound (70,000 bytes) and verifies rejection with HTTP 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.

workload_scenarios.name: Decision Deadline Timeout Overload
workload_scenarios.description: Simulates evaluation delay exceeding the 200ms SLO and verifies fail-closed rejection with HTTP 504 DECISION_TIMEOUT.

workload_scenarios.name: Client Request Cancellation
workload_scenarios.description: Simulates client disconnecting or aborting request context and verifies clean HTTP 499 cancellation without goroutine leaks.

workload_scenarios.name: Worker Saturation Guard
workload_scenarios.description: Sends requests exceeding worker pool capacity and verifies immediate fail-closed HTTP 429 rejection without thread exhaustion.

workload_scenarios.name: Durable Storage Restart Recovery
workload_scenarios.description: Executes state mutations under load, simulates engine shutdown, and verifies intact recovery upon engine restart.
